book.name: Matayu
book.title: Vaaru poia to Yesu Krisi tau Matayu iboode Matyu—Matthew

content: Pitiiŋ to Yesu puughu tooni
Ene pitiiŋ to Yesu Krisi puughu tooni. Yesu, i siŋ to kinik David, ve David i siŋ to Abaram.
Yesu puughu tooni tau Abaram ve ilam imuul izi David, ezazi tauvene: Abaram naatu Isak, Isak naatu Yakop, ve Yakop natŋa, ene: Yuda tomania tooghŋa ve tazŋa.
Yuda yesuru Tamar tipoop natuzŋa bogboog ru. Ee eeza Peres, ve ite eeza Sera. Peres naatu Ezron, ve Ezron naatu Ram.
Ram naatu Aminadap, Aminadap naatu Nason, ve Nason naatu Salmon.
Salmon yesuru Reap tipoop Boas, ve Boas yesuru azaawa Rut tipoop Obet. Obet naatu Yesi,
ve Yesi naatu, ene kinik David. David ivai Uraia azaawa Batseba, ve yesuru tipoop Solomon.
Solomon naatu Reoboam, Reoboam naatu Abia, ve Abia naatu Asa.
Asa naatu Yosapat, Yosapat naatu Yoram, ve Yoram natu Usia,
Usia naatu Yotam, Yotam naatu Aas, ve Aas naatu Esekia.
Esekia naatu Manase. Manase naatu Amon, ve Amon naatu Yosia.
Yosia natŋa, ene: Yekonia ve tazŋa siriv. Saawe tana, yes Babilona tilam tireu nugh tintiina isov to yes Yuda, ve tiyau zi gha tigherev zi tila tivot nugh toozi tau igheen malau kat.
Saawe tau yes Israela tilepleep izi Babilon, Yekonia yesuru azaawa tipoop Sealtiel, ve Sealtiel yesuru azaawa tipoop Zerubabel.
Zerubabel naatu Abiut, Abiut naatu Eliakim, ve Eliakim naatu Azor.
Azor naatu Sadok, Sadok naatu Akim, ve Akim naatu Eliut.
Eliut naatu Eleasar, Eleasar naatu Matan, ve Matan naatu Yakop.
Yakop naatu Yosep. Yosep azaawa Maria ta ipoop Yesu, i ta tiwaato tighe Krisi
na.

Tauvene Abaram naatu Isak, Isak naatu Yakop, ve paaghu toozi tiparseeŋ tauvene taghon taghon le David ivot imin saŋavul ve paaŋ (14). Ve indeeŋ saawe to David, le ila imuul saawe tau yes Babilona tiyau yes Yuda ve tigham zi tila Babilon, paaghu to David tiparseeŋ irau saŋavul ve paaŋ (14) muul. Ve saawe tau yes Yuda tipul Babilon ve timuul tila tauzi nugh toozi, le ila imuul saawe tau Krisi tiina ipoopa na, paaghu to David tiparseeŋ irau saŋavul ve paaŋ (14) muul.
Aŋela ivot to Yosep
Sinaiŋ to Yesu Krisi tiina ipoopa, ene vene: Tiina Maria, tisiigho pa ŋeer ee, eeza Yosep. Eemon yesuru tilup zi soone, ve tighilaal tighe Maria aapo. Gabua tana ivot ila Avuvu Patabuyaaŋ tapiri.
Yosep, i ŋeer duduuŋa ee, ve loolo pa igham Maria vaaru ivot ighazooŋ mako. Tauvene maata iŋgal ighe irav motin vaiŋ toozi imin ŋgozaaŋ.

Ighamgham ŋgar soone, ve Maaron aŋela tooni ivot tooni ila vivuuŋ, ve isaav pani ighe: “Yosep, yo siŋ to David, uroi pa ghamuuŋ Maria imin azuwam sov. Pa tamtamon tau igheen ila i aapo na, ene ivot ila Avuvu Patabuyaaŋ tapiri.
I pale ipoop tamoot. Ve yo aat uwaat eeza Yesu. Pa i pale igham mulin tamtamon tooni pa pataŋani to sosor toozi.”
Gabua isov tana itaghon saveeŋ tau muuŋ Maaron isavia ila propet tooni ee aavo na. Saveeŋ tauvene:

content.text: “Aghita. Livaa mbiu ee pale aapo, ve ipoop naatu tamoot.

content: Tauvene Yosep igheen le nughizau, ra iburig ve itaghon saveeŋ tau aŋela to Maaron isavia pani na, ve igham Maria imin azaawa.
Eemon igharauu mako le i ipoop naatu tamoot tawe. Ve Yosep iwaat marani tana eeza Yesu.

footnotes.text: ‘Krisi’, ene yes Grika aliŋazi. Ve ‘Mesia’, ene yes Israela aliŋazi. Pughuzi eemon: ‘Ŋeer tau tiliŋ ŋgoreeŋ izala paavo imin ilaal pani ighe i aat igham uraat tiina eta to Maaron.’ Tiwaat Yesu tighe Mesia (o Krisi) pasaa, Maaron tauu ighuru imin Uleeŋa to iit tamtamon, ve i igham mulin ghiit pa pataŋani to sosor toit.
Yesu eeza, puughu tauvene: ‘Yoova igham mulin’.
Saveeŋ Imanuel, puughu tauvene: ‘Maaron ileep tomani ghiit’.
